import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();

        int longestOutside = longestOutsideWord(s, n);
        int insideWords = countInsideWords(s, n);

        System.out.println(longestOutside + " " + insideWords);
    }

    private static int longestOutsideWord(String s, int n) {
        int max = -1;
        int current = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '_') {
                max = Math.max(max, current);
                current = 0;
            } else if (c != '(' && c != ')') {
                current++;
            } else {
                max = Math.max(max, current);
                current = 0;
                i++;
                while (s.charAt(i) != ')') {
                    i++;
                }
            }
        }
        return Math.max(max, current);
    }

    private static int countInsideWords(String s, int n) {
        int words = 0;
        int current = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (i < n && s.charAt(i) != '(') {
                i++;
            }
            if (i == n) {
                break;
            }
            i++;
            while (s.charAt(i) != ')') {
                char c = s.charAt(i);
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (current > 0) {
                        words++;
                    }
                    current = 0;
                } else {
                    current++;
                }
                i++;
            }
            if (current > 0) {
                words++;
            }
            current = 0;
        }
        return words;
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.function.BiFunction;
import java.util.function.IntUnaryOperator;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String inp = sc.next();

        IntUnaryOperator findClose = start -> {
            int j = start;
            while (inp.charAt(j) != ')') {
                j++;
            }
            return j;
        };

        BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Integer> countWords = (start, end) -> {
            int words = 0;
            int cur = 0;
            for (int j = start; j < end; j++) {
                if (inp.charAt(j) == '_') {
                    if (cur > 0) {
                        words++;
                    }
                    cur = 0;
                } else {
                    cur++;
                }
            }
            if (cur > 0) {
                words++;
            }
            return words;
        };

        int maxl = -1;
        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = inp.charAt(i);
            if (c == '_') {
                if (cur > maxl) maxl = cur;
                cur = 0;
            } else if (c != '(' && c != ')') {
                cur++;
            } else {
                if (cur > maxl) maxl = cur;
                cur = 0;
                i = findClose.applyAsInt(i + 1);
            }
        }

        if (cur > maxl) maxl = cur;

        int numwrd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (i < n && inp.charAt(i) != '(') {
                i++;
            }
            if (i == n) {
                break;
            }
            int close = findClose.applyAsInt(i + 1);
            numwrd += countWords.apply(i + 1, close);
            i = close;
        }

        System.out.println(maxl + " " + numwrd);
    }
}
